false_rejection_analysis.interpretation: Offline Intake interpreted sting as a bite hazard rather than an explosive hazard.
Offline Intake classified the press as the hazard instead of the same-level trip and fall.

Offline Intake interpreted caught as machine entanglement rather than a trip involving a cart.

evaluation_scope.confidence_note: Offline Intake receives no baseline confidence in this evaluation, so 0.5 is its default value.
